notes: Retrieval proxy, not QA accuracy: answer_hit@k = a retrieved item contains a gold answer verbatim (case-insensitive). No evidence labels exist, so recall_all and NDCG are not computed. Questions whose answer is absent from the context are dropped. FactConsolidation: one item per numbered fact, timestamps increasing with the fact number. Other sources: blank-line passages up to 1,500 characters. Runs executed on one machine, possibly concurrently with other runs.
